name: Indian Oil Corporation Limited

profile.summary: Indian Oil Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the oil, gas, petrochemicals, and alternative energy source businesses in India and internationally. It operates through Sale of Petroleum Products; Sale of Petrochemicals; Sale of Gas; and Other segments. The company is involved in the refining, pipeline transportation and marketing, exploration and production of crude oil and gas, petrochemicals, gas marketing, alternative energy sources; operates crude oil, petroleum product, and natural gas pipelines; research and development, marketing, and petrochemical businesses; wind mill and solar power generation and downstream operations.
